import pandas as pd

data = {
    "survived": [0, 1, 1, 1, 0],
    "pclass": [3, 1, 3, 1, 3],

}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Melt the DataFrame to create a countplot
df_melted = pd.melt(df, id_vars="survived", var_name="category", value_name="value")
